source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 22.2.6 (PDF 196-197) with the worked example.

blocks.text: Percentile woh qeemat hai jis se neeche data ki diye gaye feesad (percentage) qeematein aati hain. Maslan 25th percentile, jise first quartile (Q1, pehla chautha hissa) bhi kehte hain, woh qeemat hai jis se neeche 25% data hai. Isi tarah 50th percentile, yani median, woh qeemat hai jis se neeche 50% data hai, aur 75th percentile, yani third quartile (Q3), woh qeemat hai jis se neeche 75% data hai. Biostatistics mein percentiles khaas taur par faidamand hain kyunke in se biological data ki taqseem samajh aati hai, chahe data aik taraf jhuka hua (skewed) ho ya normal (ghanti numa) ho.

items: R = rank (tarteeb wale data mein jagah ka number)
n = data mein qeematon ki tadaad

blocks.text: Kitab mein formula 'R = R = P/100 (n + 1)' chhapa hai; 'R =' do baar ghalti se aa gaya hai. Formula sirf R = (P/100)(n + 1) hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki likhai

blocks.text: Agar R poora adad (integer) ho to tarteeb wale data mein Rth jagah wali qeemat hi percentile hai. Agar R poora adad na ho (maslan 4.4), to do qareebi jaghon ke darmiyan interpolation (beech ki qeemat ka andaza) se percentile nikalte hain. Maslan agar R chauthi aur paanchwi qeemat ke darmiyan ho to:

blocks.title: Percentile nikalne ke qadam (misaal)
steps: Qadam 4: R = 4.4 poora adad nahi, is liye 40th percentile chauthi (168) aur paanchwi (170) qeemat ke darmiyan hai. Interpolation: 168 + 0.4 × (170 − 168) = 168 + 0.4 × 2 = 168 + 0.8 = 168.8.
blocks.answer: 40th percentile 168.8 cm hai, yani 40% logon ki unchai 168.8 cm ya us se kam hai.

blocks.text: 4.4 ka matlab hai: chauthi jagah se 0.4 hissa aage. Chauthi aur paanchwi qeemat mein 2 cm ka farq hai; us ka 0.4 hissa 0.8 cm hai, jo 168 mein jama hota hai.
blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa percentile median hai, aur Q1 aur Q3 kaun se percentiles hain?
blocks.explanation: Median 50th percentile hai; Q1 25th percentile aur Q3 75th percentile hai.

items: Percentile: woh qeemat jis se neeche diya gaya feesad data ho.
R = (P/100)(n + 1); R poora na ho to do qareebi qeematon ke darmiyan interpolation.
